To verify the sharpness of the stitched edges and ensure no AI-generated melting or blurring occurs at the boundary between the bibs and the wooden background.
To analyze the consistency of the polka dot pattern and fabric weave, checking for subtle texture anomalies or repetitive pattern artifacts common in AI generation.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness of the bibs against the wood background
Consistency of the polka dot pattern geometry across all three items
Realism of the fabric folds and shadows where the bibs overlap
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the stitching details along the curved edges. Also, verify that the polka dots do not distort unnaturally near the curved boundaries of the bibs.
